slow-in.description: Gentle full-clip center zoom from 100% to the selected amount.

slow-out.description: Gentle full-clip center zoom out from the selected amount to 100%.

punch-in.description: Quick center punch-in, then hold the tighter frame.

punch-out.description: Quick pull-back to reveal more of the portrait frame.

pulse.description: Subtle repeating zoom pulse for short emphasis beats.
